hourly.summary: Arsenal fans are revelling in Manchester City's 115-charge nightmare, demanding points deductions that would relegate the champions multiple times over, while simultaneously celebrating their own quirky cannon-collecting community and dismissing rival fans' whataboutery about 1915. The mood is pure, uncut schadenfreude with a side of artillery obsession.

daily.summary: Arsenal fan sentiment underwent a dramatic same-day reversal, shifting from morning anxiety over Kai Havertz's hamstring injury and transfer frustration (4/10) to afternoon euphoria following Manchester City's 115-charge guilty verdict. The dominant narrative flipped from injury-curse dread to vindicated schadenfreude, with fans reveling in retrospective title dreams and rival misery.

weekly.summary: Arsenal fan sentiment traced a dramatic boom-and-bust arc across the week: cautious optimism early on built into bullish, title-chasing euphoria by mid-week, only to implode catastrophically after a 3-0 loss at Brighton on the 19th. The final two days saw sentiment plummet from peak confidence (8/10) to meltdown and despair (3/10), with Arteta's 'lack of respect' critique, exposed defensive frailties, and extinguished title hopes defining a thoroughly miserable finish.
